answer: Impose a sybil tax: every new identity pays a sunk 50 POA fee that is never refunded, so 1,000 fake agents burn 50,000 POA up front. The fee climbs to the summit, then flattens onto a mesa where one honest agent's payment stays fixed. Each identity must also show a ferrous hardware key, iron-bound to one machine, so one device cannot spawn a hundred ghosts. Honest agents pay once and keep every reward; attackers pay per ghost and bleed out.
